name: Stock Market Research Pipeline
description: Research a stock comprehensively and produce an investment report with market data, financial analysis, sentiment assessment, and a written summary.

steps.name: Market Research
steps.instructions: Research the stock or company specified in the workflow input. Gather: current price and recent performance, latest news and press releases, key financial metrics (P/E, revenue growth, margins), analyst ratings and price targets. Provide a structured summary with sources.

steps.name: Financial Analysis
steps.instructions: Using the research from step 1, perform a financial analysis. Include: valuation assessment (is it cheap or expensive vs peers?), revenue/earnings trend interpretation, key risks and opportunities, a bull case and bear case with supporting numbers. Be quantitative and specific.

steps.name: Sentiment Assessment
steps.instructions: Using the company identified in step 1, assess market sentiment. Research: recent social media and forum discussions (Reddit, Twitter/X), insider buying/selling transactions in the last 6 months, short interest data, recent institutional ownership changes. Summarize overall sentiment as bullish/neutral/bearish with evidence.

steps.name: Investment Report
steps.instructions: Using the research (step 1), financial analysis (step 2), and sentiment assessment (step 3), write a 500-800 word investment report in Markdown format. Structure: Executive Summary, Company Overview, Financial Highlights, Sentiment & Market Perception, Risk Factors, Conclusion & Outlook. Be balanced, data-driven, and clear.
